WITH type_averages AS (
    SELECT production_type_code, AVG(unit_price) AS avg_price
    FROM Products
    GROUP BY production_type_code
    HAVING AVG(unit_price) IS NOT NULL
), above_overall AS (
    SELECT production_type_code, avg_price
    FROM type_averages
    WHERE avg_price > (SELECT AVG(unit_price) FROM Products)
), kept_mean AS (
    SELECT AVG(avg_price) AS mean_kept_price
    FROM above_overall
), remaining AS (
    SELECT a.avg_price, k.mean_kept_price, (SELECT AVG(unit_price) FROM Products) AS overall_avg
    FROM above_overall a
    CROSS JOIN kept_mean k
    WHERE a.avg_price > k.mean_kept_price
)
SELECT AVG(avg_price) AS average_type_price,
       AVG(avg_price - overall_avg) AS average_above_overall_price,
       AVG(avg_price - mean_kept_price) AS average_above_kept_types_mean
FROM remaining
